gaps: VPC and subnet detail APIs do not document a terminal lifecycle state enum.
Virtual-IP bind/unbind expose in_progress/done only on the mutation response; retrieval does not expose the same state, so no mutation is repolled.
Path analysis status finish is only an example without a documented complete lifecycle enum. The report waiter is explicitly node usability, not analysis completion.
Collection and CSV batch operations without a unique scalar identity input are not bound to waiters.

validation_limitations: API4811 references addressPoolType=custom for ipv6SegmentPoolID, but exposes no addressPoolType input; no parameter is invented.
Route nextHopVpcID requirements depend on regional resource-pool class, which is not exposed as a command input.

APIs5794/5804 require address/count exclusivity and API5799 applies it within each batch entry. Bilingual help preserves the rule; current metadata validates required alternatives but does not enforce exclusivity or nested per-entry requirements. API5799 may partially succeed.
normalization_notes: Legacy page/pageNumber deprecation notices are attached to those fields, not to the recommended pageNo field. Original wording remains in upstream-evidence.json.
Source and response examples with missing quotation marks or member separators were repaired without changing values; per-operation normalization notes identify the affected APIs.
